home.title: Hey, I'm Ryan, a Senior Product Designer with over 11 years of experience in Product Design & Design Systems

blocks.text: Hey, I'm Ryan, a Senior Product Designer with over 11 years of experience in Product Design & Design Systems

By day, I'm a Senior Product Designer at Gradle on their Develocity product. In the past, I helped lead design systems at the New York Shipping Exchange as well as Ribbon Homes, and lead design for 7 years at Shoflo as their first and only designer. On the weekends, I'm helping bring accessibility to the masses through a community-wide initiative.
Keel is a bespoke design system built in Figma and on top of a comprehensive atomic design token architecture for the NYSHEX product team.
Quilt is a custom Figma-based design system for the Ribbon design & engineering team. Built rapidly and complete with documentation and accessibility.
A look into the browser-based live streaming Studio I designed and launched during Covid with the Shoflo team
Polymer is the design system I designed and maintained for the Shoflo product team. Built in Figma with accessibility as its core tenet.
Shoflo is a software platform designed to empower event production teams to build live events in a collaborative, real time environment.
thyme is a side project that offers a new way of looking at your finances through the lens of time, rather than dollars.
The a11y initiative is a side project dedicated to helping designers and developers make their websites more accessible and inclusive for all through a month long set of challenges.

About

I currently am a Senior Product Designer at New York Shipping Exchange (NYSHEX) working exclusively on design systems since January of 2023.

Prior to NYSHEX, I was one of two Senior Systems Designs at Ribbon Home responsible for designing and delivering a custom design system.

Before that, I was the only designer at Shoflo, designing live event production software and their design system.

When not tinkering with Figma, I am working on a fintech app (thyme), a community accessibility resource (a11y initiative), or on my 10+ year freelance client project helping usher in the next era of entrepreneurs.

I have been designing for 10 years with a focus on creating accessible design systems. Outside of tech, I enjoy baking, fermentation, coffee, gardening, EDM, and travel.
